name: deep-search
description: Multi-lens deep investigation, harness-agnostic: fan out one reader per lens on the same ground truth, hand every finding that claims to explain the phenomenon to an adversarial refuter (default: refuted), then synthesize the survivors into a ranked mechanism list with a fix and a red-first test. All investigation-specific content arrives through --args; neither file carries any.

stages.label: read
stages.prompt:
You are one reader in a multi-lens investigation. Ground truth you MUST explain, not re-litigate: {facts}. The question under investigation: {question}. Your lens is '{slug}': {instruction}.

Read the relevant code/history and gather findings that EXPLAIN the phenomenon. Different lenses find different things on purpose; do not try to match other lenses. For every finding that claims to explain the phenomenon, write one JSON record to the findings file below with a concrete mechanism, the evidence (file:line where possible), and a confidence 0..1.

Write your findings to {scratch}/read-{slug}.json as an ARRAY of {"mechanism":"...","evidence":"...","confidence":0.0} objects (mkdir -p {scratch} first, overwrite if present). Then respond with EXACTLY ONE JSON object and nothing else, matching this schema: {"slug":"...","found":0}.

stages.label: refute
stages.prompt:
You are the adversarial refuter for lens '{slug}' in a multi-lens investigation. The question: {question}. Ground truth (do not re-litigate): {facts}.

Read every findings file {scratch}/read-*.json (each lens wrote an array of {"mechanism","evidence","confidence"}). For EACH finding that claims to explain the phenomenon, try to kill it: check the cited evidence, look for a competing or simpler explanation, and DEFAULT TO REFUTED whenever the evidence is weak, ambiguous or unverified. Admit as a survivor only a finding whose explanation survives genuine adversarial pressure. Keep at most {refute_n} admitted findings for your lens; refute the rest.

Write your survivors to {scratch}/refute-{slug}.json as an ARRAY of {"mechanism":"...","evidence":"...","confidence":0.0,"why_survives":"..."} (mkdir -p {scratch} first, overwrite if present). Then respond with EXACTLY ONE JSON object and nothing else, matching this schema: {"slug":"...","admitted":0,"refuted":0}.

stages.label: synthesize
stages.prompt:
You synthesize a multi-lens investigation. The question: {question}. Ground truth: {facts}.

Read every survivor file {scratch}/refute-*.json (each lens wrote an ARRAY of {"mechanism","evidence","confidence","why_survives"}). Merge duplicates across lenses, rank the distinct mechanisms by weighted confidence and breadth of independent evidence, and produce a ranked list of the TOP {refute_n} mechanisms most likely to explain the phenomenon. For each ranked mechanism give a concrete fix and, where code can be tested, a red-first test that would fail before the fix and pass after.

Respond with EXACTLY ONE JSON object and nothing else, matching this schema: {"ranked":[{"mechanism":"...","evidence":"...","confidence":0.0,"fix":"...","red_first_test":"..."}],"top_mechanism":"..."}.
